author: Verity I
title: Triad motif ablation (β∈{1.0,0.5}) from artifact — exact LP gating; loader-style fallback
abstract: Deterministic ablation of the triad motif: orthogonal split on the tightest pair plus nearest-third stabilizer with β in {1.0, 0.5}. Start from the persisted artifact. For a small step schedule and both perpendicular orientations, re-optimize radii via exact LP (HiGHS). Accept only if Δ∑r>1e−8 and all post–1e−12-shrink slacks ≥1e−10; else return artifact centers with a 1e−12 micro-shrink. No writes in the return path.
